_metadata.description: Cross-domain obligations that no single product domain owns: declared measure coverage, the broader operator console, and future kernel adapters.

requirements.title: Domain measure coverage
requirements.description: Every stateful domain the Program Runtime owns MUST carry at least one declared measure in the CLI manifest, or a `measures.omitted` waiver naming the domain and its reason, so measures-health grades the scenario on a stated position rather than an absence.

validation.notes: Target `api/handlers/measures/module_test.go::TestDeclarationsCoverStatefulDomains` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-009]). Each stateful domain has a declared owner measure, while explicitly stateless domains carry a reason in the manifest.

Target `api/handlers/measures/module_test.go::TestDeclarationsCoverStatefulDomains` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-009]). The declarations are checked against the scenario manifest's stateful-domain contract, so an unknown waiver cannot silently replace a measure.

requirements.title: Operator inspection surface
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY provide an operator UI for browsing sessions, program history, and the resolved binding surface.

validation.notes: Target `ui/src/features/sessions/SessionsCard.test.tsx::renders session and program history` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-001]). Operator surface lists sessions, program history, and the resolved binding surface.

Status correction (2026-08-11): no operator sessions or program-history route is implemented. The notes example was removed by the official detemplate operation. The binding registry surface is separately earned by PRT-P1-007; this broader operator-console requirement remains planned until a real operator workflow, page, and route are implemented and tested.

requirements.title: Alternate kernel adapters
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MAY support kernel languages beyond Python where a measured capability argument justifies the added surface.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/adapter_test.go::TestKernelAdapterSeamIsLanguageNeutral` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P2-004]). The kernel adapter seam admits a non-Python kernel without changes to bindings or governance.

Status correction (2026-08-11): this requirement was marked complete against a validation target that does not exist. Verified state: `api/internal/sessions/adapter_test.go` is absent; the only `KernelFactory` coverage is in `api/internal/sessions/manager_test.go`, which exercises session lifecycle rather than language neutrality. The `sessions.Kernel`/`sessions.KernelFactory` seam is plausibly language-neutral by shape, and the wire protocol is deliberately JSON-lines so it can be, but no non-Python kernel has been admitted through it and no test asserts the property. Per this requirement's own wording, adoption also requires a measured capability argument, which does not exist either.
